title: Simple paths through a cycle
brief: Traverse a cyclic relationship without revisiting a node.
instructions: Start at node 1. Emit every simple directed category path, including the zero-hop root. A node can occur through multiple paths but never twice within one path.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes parent_id,child_id from category_edges without solving simple paths through a cycle.

Append a child only when its identity is absent from that path.
